posts.text:
Is AI actually replacing jobs? We matched AI exposure to official US employment counts for 722 occupations, May 2019 to May 2025.

Exposure explains only about 1% of the variation in job growth, and the most exposed groups (business, finance, computing) grew fastest. The real losses so far are a short list of clerical and support jobs, most of them already declining.

Check your own job with our free lookup: link in bio.

posts.text:
Are Black Friday deals actually real? We tracked 33 popular products at 13 big UK retailers for a year.

None of them hit their lowest price of the year on Black Friday 2025, and every price was matched or beaten within six months. But 29 of the 33 were cheaper than usual, typically by 11% (£35), and Black Friday to Cyber Monday was the cheapest stretch on average.

Check any deal with our free checker: link in bio.
